en.title: Pikmin 4 Enhanced Edition Drops New Dandori Academy Trailer for Switch 2
en.summary: Nintendo is reminding fans about the upcoming release of Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy with a fresh overview trailer. The enhanced port promises significant upgrades and a brand-new game mode.
en.body:
While the gaming world eagerly anticipates massive releases like the **The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time** remake, Nintendo is quietly preparing another significant launch for its next-generation console. **Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy** is set to arrive on November 12th, 2026, and a new overview trailer has just dropped, giving players a closer look at what to expect.

This isn't just a simple port; the **Nintendo Switch 2 Edition** boasts higher resolution graphics, bringing the charming world of **Pikmin** to life with even greater detail. A standout feature is the new **Dandori Academy** mode, which will offer a staggering 72 stages. These challenges will be released gradually, providing a steady stream of strategic gameplay for dedicated fans. Furthermore, the port introduces voice command functionality for **Oatchi**, your loyal canine companion, allowing for more intuitive control during frantic missions. Online multiplayer also gets a boost with **GameChat** and **GameShare** integration for **Dandori Battles**, expanding the competitive possibilities beyond local play.

## Mastering the Dandori Academy

The **Dandori Academy** appears to be a core pillar of this enhanced **Pikmin 4** experience. With 72 planned stages, it suggests a robust training ground designed to hone players' strategic planning and resource management skills. This mode is likely to appeal to both newcomers looking to grasp the fundamentals of **Pikmin** gameplay and seasoned veterans seeking to refine their **Dandori** techniques. The gradual release of stages implies an ongoing commitment to content, keeping the community engaged long after launch. The trailer showcased glimpses of these academy challenges, hinting at increasingly complex scenarios that will test even the most experienced captains.

## A Strategic Leap Forward

The introduction of **Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy** signifies Nintendo's continued commitment to the **Pikmin** series. The addition of voice commands for **Oatchi** and enhanced online multiplayer modes via **GameChat** and **GameShare** are significant quality-of-life improvements and expansions that cater directly to player feedback and modern gaming expectations. This release isn't just about graphical upgrades; it's about deepening the strategic depth and accessibility of the core gameplay loop. For fans who have been captivated by the series' unique blend of real-time strategy and charming exploration, this enhanced edition promises to be the definitive way to experience **Pikmin 4**.

## What's Next

**Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy** launches exclusively for the **Nintendo Switch 2** on November 12th, 2026. Keep an eye out for further details on specific **Dandori Academy** stage releases and potential demo availability.
